summary: The ETraining page is a part of the HSPnet system that manages user sessions and facilitates login redirection to a Moodle training environment. It includes a form with hidden fields for username and password, which are pre-filled based on user session data.
purpose: To provide an interface for users to be redirected to the Moodle training platform using their session credentials.

fields.name: form1
fields.description: Main form for user data submission to the Moodle platform.

fields.name: username
fields.description: Stores the concatenated province code and user ID.

fields.name: password
fields.description: Stores the session ID as the password.

fields.name: Submit
fields.description: Submit button to send the form data.

actors.description: Interacts with the ETraining page to access the Moodle training platform.
Handles user session validation and builds the form action URL based on configuration.

workflows.name: Login Redirection
steps: System checks if user session is active.
If active, the form action is set to Moodle login URL.
Hidden fields 'username' and 'password' are set with session details.
User submits the form to be redirected to Moodle.
If session is inactive, redirects to Timedout page.

business_rules: User session ID must be greater than 0 for Moodle redirection.
Redirect to Timedout page if session is invalid.

conditions.description: Check if UserSession.SessionID > 0 to proceed with Moodle redirection.
Appends language parameter to URL if user's locale is French (fr-CA).

system_behavior: Redirects user to Moodle login page with pre-filled credentials if session is valid.
Redirects to Timedout page if session is invalid.
dependencies: HSPnet.DataLayer for session management and configurations.
MoodleTrainingURL configuration for determining destination URL.
exceptions: User is redirected to Timedout.aspx if session validation fails.
